responsibilities: Ownership, development, and maintenance of the Data Science & Analytics COE data products portfolio
Identify and deliver actionable insights and recommendations to key stakeholders across the organization
Own and develop analytics tools and processes that promote data driven decision making throughout the company
Lead dashboard, application, dataset, and tool validation and documentation initiatives
Partner with stakeholders to build queries and data visualizations for ad-hoc requests and existing dashboards/reports
Work with IT and cross functional teams to identify data sources, determine data collection and design aggregation mechanisms
Serve as liaison between the data teams and upstream engineering teams and participate in data governance activities as a key contributor
Manage the analytics intake process and workflows
Serve as one of the admins of the business intelligence toolkit
Mentor and collaborate with junior Analytics Engineers

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: data governance activities while maintaining compliance
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour: the summary frames the role around "data governance activities while maintaining compliance" and a responsibility to "Lead dashboard, application, dataset, and tool validation", with no speed or shipping language anywhere.
evidence.domain_risk: Experience in medical device, healthcare, or manufacturing industries is desirable
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: High: a medical-device employer asking for "HIPAA experience a plus" and compliance-bound governance work puts errors into regulated-health territory.
evidence.collaboration_width: data scientists; data engineers; IT; upstream engineering teams; junior Analytics Engineers
evidence.data_team_maturity: will be part of Insulet’s Data Science & Analytics Center of Excellence
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mature: the role joins an existing "Data Science & Analytics Center of Excellence" with separate data scientists and data engineers, an established data products portfolio, and junior Analytics Engineers to mentor.
evidence.jd_authorship: Serve as one of the admins of the business intelligence toolkit
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Mixed: concrete bullets like "Manage the analytics intake process and workflows" and "Serve as one of the admins of the business intelligence toolkit" sit next to boilerplate such as "promote data driven decision making throughout the company".
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Serve as liaison between the data teams and upstream engineering teams and participate in data governance activities as a key contributor
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Internal_data: the named partners are the data function and engineering, and the role administers the BI toolkit and the analytics intake process rather than serving one commercial or finance audience.
evidence.autonomy_level: Own and develop analytics tools and processes
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Mixed: ownership verbs ("Own and develop analytics tools and processes", "Lead dashboard ... validation") run alongside scoped delivery work, "build queries and data visualizations for ad-hoc requests".
evidence.ai_role_explanation: None: the JD never mentions AI, ML tooling, or AI-assisted coding in either responsibilities or requirements.
evidence.testing_framing: Lead dashboard, application, dataset, and tool validation and documentation initiatives
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility: validation is a bullet the candidate leads, not a tool in a skills list, reinforced by "Demonstrated knowledge of database and dataset validation best practices".
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: responsible for the analytics project intake and working with business stakeholders, data scientists, and data engineers on the data products lifecycle and data governance activities while maintaining compliance
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High: compliance and governance appear in the role summary itself, so the framing is about regulated exposure rather than pipeline uptime.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Ownership, development, and maintenance of the Data Science & Analytics COE data products portfolio
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mixed: the JD pairs building new data products with maintaining an existing portfolio and "existing dashboards/reports".
evidence.loss_aversion: "data governance activities while maintaining compliance" — compliance is named in the opening role summary, alongside HIPAA experience in the requirements, framing the risk as regulatory rather than operational.
